title: Latest 3D Work: LLM Iteration and Trellis2 + Deterministic Cleanups
body:
Two directions in my latest 3D work: a conventional space fleet built through LLM iteration, and ten Trellis2 models with deterministic geometry and material cleanups. Varied triangle budgets, mostly 2–20k; the egg is about 1k.
